finding: Six exterior images contain large horizontal/spatial tears in the released HDF5 uint8 RGB arrays before video encoding. The updated 30fps overlay faithfully retains them. This is distinct from pose/axis jitter, exposure flicker, and display sampling judder.

source_proof.hardware_cause: Unknown: capture, buffering or upstream preprocessing may have produced the tears; exact device or transport fault is not established.
source_proof.screenshot_match: The displaced upper band and hand position match source frame 105 at nominal 3.50 s.

decoder_validation.interpretation: Both decoders preserve the same large tears; sub-level average RGB conversion differences do not explain them. Original raw RGB arrays independently establish that corruption predates both decoders.

false_positive.reason: The clean image lies between two differently torn neighbors 103 and 105; bottom-band sandwich test mistakes it for an outlier.

offline_detector.coverage: All 801 sample image frames scored; all 267 original exterior images visually inspected.

training_proxy_replay.why: At stride 2, corrupt frame 105 becomes a neighbor of frame 103; the two-sided isolated-frame assumption fails. This replay is on whole episode arrays; individual sampled windows and boundary halos can differ.

filter_recommendation.current_diet: Parent audit found no DexWild dataset block in current nano_final_training. This is a candidate for later onboarding, not a claim that the dataset is currently trained or filtered.
filter_recommendation.dataset_scope: the matched one-episode sample export only
filter_recommendation.training_policy: Reject sampled windows containing a confirmed bad frame in any used view; do not delete or retime source rows.
filter_recommendation.validation_display_policy: Hold-last may conceal one-frame damage if explicitly labeled, but does not restore the recorded image and should not be used as image/pose ground truth.

quality_candidate.identity: Exact gallery sample export ID and info hash recorded; candidate is not applied and is not a full-dataset scan.

limitations: Only episode 0 was audited. A full DexWild scan with reviewed coverage is needed before dataset-wide activation.
Image interpolation cannot recover missing source pixels. Window rejection protects training; concealment only changes display.
Palm cameras have zero automatic tear flags in this sample; absence of flags is not proof of absence of all possible visual defects.
Existing camera mount calibration and pose noise are unchanged.
No canonical data, training configuration, website or ALOHA changes were made by this agent.
